question: Which of the following is/are NOT a source of geothermal energy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biomass**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Point__**

__
 
• Geothermal Energy:

 
 
• The heat that comes from the earth's subsurface is known as geothermal energy.
 
• It can be present in the minerals and fluids underneath the earth's surface, as well as in the hot molten rock known as magma.
 
• Mile-deep wells are drilled into underground lakes to access steam and hot water, which can then be used to power turbines attached to electricity generators.
 
• Dry steam, flash, and binary geothermal power plants are the three types of geothermal power plants.
 
 
• The oldest type of geothermal technology is dry steam, which extracts steam from the ground and uses it to directly drive a turbine.
 
• Binary plants move hot water into a second liquid with a lower boiling point, which transforms to vapour to drive the turbine,
 
• Flash plants use high-pressure hot water in cold, low-pressure water.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Uses of geothermal energy - 
 
• The heating system of buildings :
 
 
• Individual buildings can be heated directly with geothermal energy, or multiple buildings can be heated with district heating systems.
 
• For heating, hot water near the earth's surface is piped into houses.
 
 
 
• Generating electricity:
 
 
• ​It is used to generate electricity.
 
• The USA is one of the largest generators of geothermally induced electricity.
 
• The electricity generated can be used for different purposes.
 
• It acts as a green fuel and is eco-friendly. 
 
 
 
• Heat pumps:
 
 
• ​A geothermal heat pump, also known as a ground source heat pump, is a form of heat pump that exchanges heat with the ground, usually via a vapour-compression refrigeration cycle, to heat and/or cool a house.
 
• The three uses of geothermal energy are generating electricity, using it for the heating system of buildings, and as heat pumps.
